National Skill Development Corporation and Cultus Education Launches Nationwide Cloud and AI Skilling Initiative with Support from Amazon Web Services (AWS)
articles.full_content:
Empowering Tier 2 and Tier 3 Youth with Future Skills is Key to Viksit Bharat 2047: Shri Jayant Chaudhary Program plans to equip 150,000 learners with foundational cloud literacy and 10,000 intensive trainees with job-ready cloud and AI skills through the AWS re/Start program and other AWS digital training content — prioritizing youth in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across all states and territories
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC), under the guidance of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India, and Cultus Education announced the launch of a nationwide cloud and AI skilling initiative in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS). The initiative provides 150,000 learners with foundational AI and cloud literacy through AWS digital training content and delivers intensive, job-ready training to 10,000 participants through the AWS re/Start program — a free, cohort-based workforce development training program that helps individuals build cloud computing skills and connects participants with employment opportunities at local employers. Graduates gain access to qualified interview opportunities.
NSDC and Cultus, with AWS re/Start and AWS digital training content as the enablement programs, aim to address the challenges faced by youth in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities — including limited access to globally recognised technical training, few connections to technology employers, and an absence of credentials needed to compete for cloud and AI roles. Delivered 100% online through Cultus, the NSDC-selected delivery partner, the initiative will span all states and territories and prioritise youth in underserved communities. The program concludes with a National Hackathon.
Shri Jayant Chaudhary, Minister of State (Independent Charge) for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship and Minister of State for Education, Government of India, said, “This initiative reflects the vision of Viksit Bharat, where access to opportunity is not determined by geography or background. As India moves towards becoming a global hub for innovation, technology and talent, it is essential that our youth in Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns also get the opportunity to equipped themselves with the skills needed for the jobs of the future. Such initiatives will play an important role in building an inclusive, skilled and future-ready workforce, which is central to our journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047.”
Rani Burchmore, APJC Lead, AWS Skilling & Social Impact, said, "AWS re/Start brings 'net-new' talent into the workforce, establishing a win-win-win scenario for individuals to launch successful careers in cloud, organisations to increase their competitive edge with in-demand talent, and communities to thrive and grow. We are proud to work with NSDC and Cultus Education to build the diverse, robust cloud workforce of the future, enabling organisations to accelerate their innovation with the AWS Cloud.”

MSME Ministry Organises Entrepreneurship Awareness Programme at IIT Goa on World Entrepreneurship Day
articles.full_content:
Experts, Bankers, Academicians and Successful Entrepreneurs Guide Students on Building Start-ups and MSMEs﻿
Goa, August 22, 2026: ﻿
To mark World Entrepreneurship Day, the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India, through the MSME Development & Facilitation Office (DFO), Goa, organised an Entrepreneurship Awareness Programme at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Goa on 21 August.﻿
The programme aimed to encourage students to consider entrepreneurship as a promising career option and to create awareness about various government schemes available for aspiring entrepreneurs.﻿
The event was organised in collaboration with the Institute Innovation and Incubation Cell (IIIC) and the Entrepreneurship Cell of IIT Goa. It brought together students, entrepreneurs, MSME stakeholders, policymakers, representatives from financial institutions and industry experts for discussions on entrepreneurship, innovation and business development.﻿
Addressing the gathering, Shri M.K. Meena, Director, MSME DFO Goa, highlighted the growing role of digital commerce in helping MSMEs expand beyond geographical boundaries and access national and global markets. He stressed the need for stronger collaboration between the Centre and State governments to create an ecosystem that supports innovation, growth and competitiveness among MSMEs.﻿
Prof. Sashidhar Sampathiao, Faculty-in-Charge of the Institute Incubation and Innovation Council at IIT Goa, underlined the importance of innovation and academia-industry collaboration in nurturing entrepreneurship and helping MSMEs develop new products and technologies. ﻿
The welcome address was delivered by Shri Rohit Kumar Debnath, Assistant Director, MSME DFO Goa, who emphasised the importance of creating opportunities for MSMEs and young entrepreneurs to move from local markets to wider national and international platforms.﻿
The technical sessions focused on the MSME ecosystem, government support schemes and opportunities available for first-time entrepreneurs. ﻿
Shri Amartya Narayan Chowdhury, Assistant Director Grade-I, delivered a keynote session on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), explaining how innovators and start-up founders can safeguard their ideas and innovations. ﻿
Experts from the Directorate of Industries, Government of Goa, Central Bank of India and other industry domains shared practical guidance on start-up funding, business opportunities and entrepreneurship development.﻿
The programme also highlighted the Entrepreneurship Awareness Programme (EAP), a key component of the Ministry of MSME’s Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP), which seeks to educate aspiring entrepreneurs on market access, e-commerce, packaging and other aspects of business growth.﻿
Students and aspiring entrepreneurs actively participated in the sessions, gaining valuable insights into emerging opportunities in entrepreneurship, innovation and digital commerce.﻿
